[SWS_SM_00635] Failing to prepare for update
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
If
Modelled Process
controlling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
fails to pre-
pare for the update process, it shall return
kOperationFailed
error from the
Pre-
pareUpdate
method.
⌋
When
Modelled Process
controlling
StateMachine
of type
Controller
is finally
ready for update it should return a positive response back to
Update and Config-
uration Management
.
